notes:
Console 2.3.46. A subject nobody sat prints a dash, not a zero.
- An unmarked subject shows a dash in A1-A3, formative, exam, total and grade, so it never looks like a failure
- Every marked subject prints a comment: the teacher's own, else the grade remark from the scheme
- INITIALS always prints: the subject's own, else the assigned teacher's, else the standard sign-off (MD, MF, AKD, SJ, KJ, A, AK, K)
- The class teacher and head teacher boxes fill with the learner's own figures (average, position, division) when nobody typed a remark
- Word output matches the printed card
